subject.title: iOS/WebChat messages append to transcript but do not trigger/deliver assistant replies

question: Should #97983 stay scoped to the native iOS/WebChat ingress no-run path until a current-main real-device repro proves the first failing hop after the reply-session fixes?
rationale: Source and history show adjacent reply-session fixes, but only a maintainer-owned live repro can separate a fixed conflict family from the still-reported native iOS WebSocket/chat.send/session routing failure.

options.title: Keep Canonical And Reproduce Native iOS
options.body: Leave #97983 open, reproduce native iOS against current main or the latest beta, and then route the fix to the first failing hop shown by Gateway and client logs.

options.title: Split To Narrow Sub-Issues
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella but file narrower follow-ups only after live proof separates handshake, client-id, session route, and reply-session conflict causes.

options.title: Close As Conflict-Family Fixed
options.body: Close only if maintainers have real native iOS proof that current main now emits `chat.send`, dispatches a run, and delivers an assistant reply for the reported path.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical And Reproduce Native iOS
recommendation.body: Leave #97983 open, reproduce native iOS against current main or the latest beta, and then route the fix to the first failing hop shown by Gateway and client logs.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the current assignee and have recent adjacent iOS/session routing history, making them the best available owner for the repro-scoping decision.
